newsitem.title: ITALY: Spain extradites Lauro hijacker back to Italy.
newsitem.headline: Spain extradites Lauro hijacker back to Italy.

text.p: Spain extradited a Palestinian back to Italy on Wednesday, who was convicted of the 1985 hijacking of the Achille Lauro cruise ship and held primarily responsible for the murder of a wheelchair-bound Jewish-American passenger.
Airport sources said a private Falcon 200 jet carrying Magied al-Molqi from Madrid landed at Rome's Ciampino military airport at 1445 GMT amid tight security.
Molqi had been serving a 30-year sentence for hijacking the Italian liner but failed to return to Rome's Rebibbia jail on February 28 following 12 days' leave for good behaviour.
He was arrested in southern Spain in March by Italian anti-terrorism officers working with the Spanish Civil Guard.

The United States had offered a $2 million reward for the capture of Molqi, who was held primarily responsible at his trial in Italy for the murder of Jewish-American passenger Leon Klinghoffer on the Achille Lauro.
Klinghoffer was shot dead and his body was dumped overboard after Palestinian commandos seized the ship off Egypt.
